purpose: Crimson Oath production sprites, references supplied by the user

prompts.knight:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite atlas for Crimson Oath, a dark fantasy top-down action roguelite. Input images 1-5 are STYLE/DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Image 2 is the design reference: rugged brown-haired male lion knight, silver plate armour with antique gold lion pauldrons, grey fur collar, tattered crimson cape, huge broad steel greatsword. Heavy heroic build.
Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, exact regular 4 column by 3 row grid, 12 equally sized square cells, no gutters or labels. Requested canvas 2048x1536. Fixed slightly elevated three-quarter game camera, character facing RIGHT in every cell, full body and weapon wholly inside cell, consistent identity, proportions, scale and lighting. Painterly realistic high detail 2D pre-rendered dark fantasy ARPG art matching supplied reference, not pixel art, not chibi, strong clear silhouette at small size. Character including equipment should fit within central 80% of cell; feet fixed at local x=50%, y=93.75%. No floor, no scenery, no baked cast shadow, no UI or letters. Transparent everywhere except character.
ROW 1: four-frame subtle idle loop (breathing, cloak moving).
ROW 2: four DISTINCT frames of a running cycle: right leg forward, passing, left leg forward, passing; believable leg and arm motion, fixed camera and fixed foot anchor, never horizontal translation.
ROW 3: four DISTINCT basic attack frames: anticipation, windup, weapon strike to the right, recovery. Bow drawing/releasing for ranger, casting with staff for mage, blade swing for knight/rogue. No projectiles, slash trails or spell VFX; those are drawn separately by engine.
Every row is THE SAME character, one character per cell, all 12 cells populated. Anatomically coherent limbs and weapons. All feet aligned at identical baseline in each cell.

prompts.enemies-a:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for Crimson Oath dark fantasy top-down 2D action game. Attached monster poster is a DESIGN AND STYLE REFERENCE. Reinterpret its creatures as clear readable full-body game sprites, painterly realistic pre-rendered ARPG art with dark outlines and rim lighting. Create ONE transparent PNG sheet arranged EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS by 5 ROWS; equal square cells, NO gutters, NO labels, NO text, NO UI, NO scenery, NO floor or cast shadows. Canvas requested 1536x1920.
ROW 1: hunched grey-green feral ghoul with elongated claws and ragged cloth. ROW 2: red-eyed dark brown vampire bat with leathery wings; four distinctly different wing flaps, wings spread, half closed, down, up. ROW 3: skeletal bowman with bone ribs and rusty longbow. ROW 4: hulking grey-skinned horned brute with huge stone club and skull belt. ROW 5: deep crimson hooded cultist carrying a small pink ritual orb.
Each row contains FOUR poses of the SAME creature in a four frame locomotion loop facing RIGHT (slightly elevated three-quarter camera): stride A, passing A, stride B, passing B; floating creatures sway and change cloak shape, bat flaps wings. SAME scale, identity, equipment and camera across all four frames. Every creature including weapons/wings fully contained inside its square cell with generous clear edge padding; feet centered horizontally at x50%, y90% of local cell (floating creatures bottom at y90%). Entire character plus equipment fits within 82% of cell height and width. No creature touches another cell. Four cells per row exactly. Ordinary monsters have distinguishable silhouettes and subdued skin/armour; crimson, blue or violet glow only where appropriate. Transparent background outside creatures, including between limbs and around fine cloth edges.
